verdict.rationale: Jules's API docs say it can be used to build custom workflows that 'automate tasks like bug fixing and code reviews,' including embedding it in GitHub. That makes PR review possible only through a self-built integration. Every other item describes Jules writing code and opening its own PRs for humans to review, not reviewing incoming PRs. Missing for 10: a native automatic review triggered on every pull request, AI-generated inline PR comments, first-party docs on configuring PR review, and any hands-on corroboration of Jules acting as a reviewer.
